metadata.description: Harris Teeter grocery pickup for Claude — search products with prices, build the cart, list pickup times and start checkout. harristeeter.com serves its API only to a real browser, so every request routes through the user's own signed-in harristeeter.com tab via the ContextMint Bridge browser extension, reusing their session. Placing the order stays a click in the browser.

plugins.name: harristeeter-mcp
plugins.description: MCP server for Harris Teeter — groceries, cart, pickup times and checkout
